tweets.text:
The Claude Security plugin for Claude Code is now available in beta. 

Scan your changes for vulnerabilities before you commit, or run a full scan across your codebase, all from your terminal on the Claude inference you already run.

tweets.author: @reach_vb
tweets.text:
Reintroducing Codex Security plugin!

point it at a codebase or diff and it can build a threat model, map attack paths, validate findings, generate + test fixes, and export results to SARIF, GitHub, Jira or Linear.

oh, and it all open source on github!!

tweets.author: @svpino
tweets.text:
Teach your agents what to do by "showing" them.

This is how you teach other people: You sit them next to you, open a browser, click, click, and done.

The beauty of Open Teach is that it works with any agent and any model.

You can self-host this. Your data stays yours.

tweets.author: @svpino
tweets.text:
I had to learn 4 different tools to make a video ad.

You can now make a 10x better ad with Claude Code or Codex using the Topview MCP server.

Best part: it comes with built-in access to Amazon, YouTube, TikTok Shop, and Shopee, so you don't need to wire anything up.
